ability.background.name: Background Tasks
background.start.desc: Start a process background task (--name --command <json argv> [--cwd] [--description])
background.job.desc: Start a registered background job (--name <handler> --args <json>), e.g. download
background.signal.desc: Send a signal to a task (--id --signal SIGINT)
background.stop.desc: Stop a task (--id, process: SIGTERM→SIGKILL; job: cancel)
background.remove.desc: Remove a finished task from the list (--id)
background.clear-finished.desc: Remove all stopped/finished tasks at once
